reader.requirement: At --std 85, in a report with a PAGE clause, no line of the report footing may be presented below the page limit (integer-1), whatever positions it: an absolute LINE, relative lines placed from FOOTING when no page footing precedes it, or relative lines placed from the final LINE-COUNTER the page footing establishes (its last line, or its NEXT GROUP setting) when one does (§1985:XIII.3.10.10 GR3 b); a description that would do so is in error (§1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR1, §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR8 f).

reader.notes: Absolute report-footing lines and relative ones placed from FOOTING are held to the page limit at compile time. A report footing of relative lines after a page footing is checked only from the FOOTING seed: ScreenReportGroupLines calls MinimumLastLine(g, model) with no seed, though at 85 the page footing always prints first on that page (no PRESENT WHEN) and GR3 b places the footing after its final LINE-COUNTER. The description compiles and the RWCS prints the footing below the page limit.
